versionFieldNote: Only allowlistVersion is machine-checked: extraction/verify_all.py (allowlist-version) fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json. counts are machine-checked too (counts check; --update-counts rewrites them). repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are hand-maintained documentation markers; nothing checks them automatically (pageSpecVersion is additionally pinned as a const inside the generated schema).
themeNote: dark is the site-wide theme; contest and ships-legacy are scoped sub-themes applied by a page wrapper on /contest, /contest-submission and /ships only (THEME_SCOPED rule).
countsNote: Recomputed from the files by extraction/verify_all.py.

sourceProject.description: External evidence, NOT part of this package: the Vite + React + Tailwind clone in the folder that contains design-repo/ (src/, public/, tailwind.config.js, src/index.css, src/data/, specs/, CLONE_SPEC.md, CLONE_ASSETS.md, sitemap-routes.txt). Every citation is relative to that folder.
sourceProject.versionsReadFrom: the source project's package.json (declared ranges) and node_modules/<pkg>/package.json (resolved); external evidence
sourceProject.snapshotNote: A snapshot of the clone as implemented on the snapshot date ('record as it is'): re-diff versions, counts and claims if the source changes.

sourceNote: The source is a clone of a REAL, LIVE company's site (Foreplay, foreplay.co). Brand name, logo, product imagery, customer logos and testimonial headshots belong to Foreplay or third parties. This repository is for local/internal use only and must not be published; generated pages must never reproduce real logos, real people's photos/names or real proprietary content (see assets/asset-roles.json globalProhibitions and the PERSON_PLACEHOLDER / ASSET_REF_POLICY validator rules).

constraints.noOutboundShellLinks: Navbar and footer contain no external links (removed: Sign in, Knowledge Base, Merch, API Docs, Feature Requests, Roadmap, Ask-AI row, social icons; rerouted: Chrome Extension -> /chrome-extension, review badges -> /chrome-extension and /reviews, Start free trial -> /pricing, Book a Call -> /book-demo). Enforced by NO_OUTBOUND_SHELL_LINKS.
constraints.noThirdPartyRequests: Every third-party embed is a same-size placeholder (assetRole third-party-embed, placeholder-only); forms never submit.
constraints.copyPolicy: Homepage copy is the user's own saved copy; all other long copy is deliberately stand-in text of matching length; contracts store character budgets (maxChars), never real text.
